planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
The page shows the brand `Mosaic` and the text `Information changes.`
The page shows the button or link `Sign in to your workspace`.
The page shows the three feature headings `Cited to the exact words`, `Nothing moves until you approve` and `Undo that respects later work`.
Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the navigation link `How it works`.
The heading `From revised brief to settled work` is visible.
The four steps `Bring a source`, `Review the change`, `Apply with care` and `Keep the history` are visible, in that order.

name: Sign-in page from the landing page

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the header link named exactly `Sign in`.
The URL path is `/login`.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible, with an `Email` field, a `Password` field and a `Sign in` button.
There is no option to create an account or register.

name: Signed-out visitor cannot open the workspace

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/app` on the target preview origin without signing in.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible and no task board, workspace selector or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Judge lobby without a link shows no seats

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The message `This lobby link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No seat buttons (for example `Seat 1`) are shown.

name: Access link page without a token is refused

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/access` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Link not accepted` is visible.
The message `This access link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No task board or `Sign out` button is shown.
